guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: currencyservice_socket is the only strongly anomalous series (3 -> 7.82, +160.7%, z=+32.13), and every one of the worst traces passes through currencyservice. Memory is only mildly up (z=+1.91) and the logs hold no warnings or errors, so the socket signal is the sole strong evidence, with the trace-path correlation as support.

proposed_fix.description: Inspect currencyservice's open connections and connection handling, then restart or roll back the currencyservice instance if the socket leak is confirmed. Add connection limits and timeouts for its callers.
